classification: Node #115 work allocation using inherited reference paths; inferred scopes require target-specific call-graph validation.

components.name: Foundation utilities
components.scope: Time, logging, wallets, collections and shared runtime utilities
components.first_task: Map time/quantity conversion helpers; distinguish standard-library code from private helpers.

components.name: Serialization fork
components.scope: Private bincode wire codecs and integer encodings
components.first_task: Recover varint boundaries and encoding mode; compare malformed, truncated and boundary inputs.

components.name: Storage and snapshots
components.scope: RocksDB wrappers, block readers and database lifecycle
components.first_task: Recover key/value schemas and snapshot versioning before replay.

components.name: Network transport
components.scope: TCP framing, LZ4, channels, rate limits and reconnects
components.first_task: Map frame lengths, compression boundaries and error handling without network traffic.

components.name: Consensus
components.scope: Votes, rounds, quorum certificates, validator sets and timers
components.first_task: Map signed wire types and quorum arithmetic; validate invalid signatures and timeout transitions.

components.name: Node runtime and gossip
components.scope: CLI, startup, gossip, stream services and process orchestration
components.first_task: Trace CLI dispatch to service entrypoints and enumerate read/write side effects.

components.name: Block execution and state
components.scope: Block application, state roots and checkpoint handoff
components.first_task: Bind begin/action/end-block call paths and state-root inputs for #115.

components.name: Action wire and signing
components.scope: Action envelopes, signing payloads and delayed actions
components.first_task: Recover tags, signing domains, replay checks and error precedence.

components.name: Action dispatch and handlers
components.scope: Agent-created handler splits and central dispatch
components.first_task: Validate each handler seed against #115; do not infer original function boundaries from these splits.

components.name: Exchange orchestration
components.scope: Trading orchestration, block hooks, deployment and ledger updates
components.first_task: Trace order placement through risk checks, matching, fees and ledger writes.

components.name: Order books and matching
components.scope: Book storage, price/time priority and order lifecycle
components.first_task: Recover matching and cancel/modify transitions with exact rounding and overflow behavior.

components.name: Clearinghouses and risk
components.scope: Positions, margin, oracles, liquidations and spot balances
components.first_task: Map margin/liquidation formulas and state mutations; prove sign and unit conventions.

components.name: Assets and fixed-point quantities
components.scope: Price, size, notional and wei arithmetic plus asset metadata
components.first_task: Start with bounded arithmetic helpers: recover width, rounding, scale and overflow branches.

components.name: Fees and volume
components.scope: Fee tiers, volume accounting and rebates
components.first_task: Recover maker/taker fee formulas and time-window rollover.

components.name: Vaults and subaccounts
components.scope: Vault and subaccount accounting and permissions
components.first_task: Recover share accounting, transfer restrictions and liquidation interaction.

components.name: Bridge and withdrawals
components.scope: Deposit/withdrawal requests and cross-chain signing
components.first_task: Map message hashes, nonce lifecycle and validator signing threshold.

components.name: HyperEVM execution
components.scope: EVM state, database adapters, transaction execution and hashing
components.first_task: Identify reth/revm private fork boundaries and state transition inputs.

components.name: Staking and validator lifecycle
components.scope: Stake, validator membership and jailing
components.first_task: Recover stake accounting and epoch transitions separately for #115.

components.name: DEX registry
components.scope: DEX metadata and clearinghouse registry
components.first_task: Recover identifiers, lookup rules and deployment ownership checks.

components.name: Remaining L1 state helpers
components.scope: Agent, system-user, nonce, timing and other cross-cutting state
components.first_task: Classify each remaining path by actual call graph; avoid dropping uncategorized helpers.

components.name: Info API
components.scope: Read-only info requests and position responses
components.first_task: Recover request variants, response layouts and snapshot consistency.

components.name: EVM JSON-RPC
components.scope: JSON-RPC routing, EVM reads and transaction forwarding
components.first_task: Map method dispatch and wire errors against the captured release.

components.name: Global configuration
components.scope: Static network/build configuration and naming
components.first_task: Separate constants observed in binary data from illustrative source defaults.
